issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale with a TODO instead of completing the Union -> | migration the PR promises.
issues.detail: The PR description states Union types should be replaced with A | B, but ruff.toml blanket-ignores exactly those rules with a TODO. This leaves the codebase in a two-dialect state with no enforced boundary. Either land the auto-fix as the next patch in the series or scope the ignore narrowly with a tracking link.

issues.description: default_raise() shim and stale <3.10 comments left behind after kw_only_dataclass removal.
issues.detail: With kw_only=True universal, required fields can simply omit defaults. Keeping field(default_factory=default_raise) as a required-field sentinel produces RuntimeError at construct time instead of TypeError at the call boundary, and the comment above TransactionEndpointRequest still cites the <3.10 rationale. Remove the shim or update the comment to state the real invariant.

issues.description: Debug `dnf search python3.12` left in install-scripts CI step.
issues.detail: Amazon/Rocky prep steps run `dnf search python3.12` before installing. Search output is not part of the install contract, adds noise, and a non-zero exit could mask the real failure. Drop the search line or gate it behind an explicit availability check so the step fails on the actual install postcondition.

issues.description: install.sh minor-version guard still allows Python 3.7-3.9 while the error message claims >= 3.10.
issues.detail: The check reads PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7, but the printed message now says ">= 3.10". A 3.8 interpreter passes the guard and prints a contradictory message. Bump the literal to 10 so the code matches the string.

issues.description: option() default_default fallback removed without documenting the narrowed contract.
issues.detail: Previously option() returned default=None on <3.10 and MISSING on >=3.10; now it is unconditionally MISSING. Callers that relied on the implicit None default will see a different exception shape. Add a one-line docstring stating the new precondition: callers must supply default= explicitly or accept MISSING.

synthesis.summary: The Python 3.9 removal is mechanically correct and the kw_only consolidation is a real ADT simplification — cmd_classes.py shows the right shape for collapsing version forks. However, the patch is half-done: ruff's UP007/UP035/UP045 are blanket-ignored with a TODO instead of running the auto-fix, default_raise and its <3.10 comments survive as dead scaffolding in wallet_request_types.py, install.sh's guard still admits 3.7-3.9 while claiming 3.10+, and a debug `dnf search` line snuck into CI. Finish the ruff conversion (or land it as the next patch), strip the stale compatibility shims, and tighten the install.sh and workflow steps.
